info.title: OpenRealtime Wire Protocol
info.description: Frame protocol spoken over the Transport Adapter Seam (server/transport/). Generated from server/transport/frames.py by scripts/generate_asyncapi.py — do not hand-edit.

session.description:
A single logical session over one Endpoint Session (see
endpoint_session/registry.py and ADR-0019). The client sends
`session_hello` first on any new physical connection, optionally with
`resume_session_id` to reattach to a session that survived a prior
disconnect within its grace period. The server always replies with
`session_ack`, carrying the `session_id` to use going forward and whether
it was resumed or freshly minted. All other frames may flow in either
direction after that handshake completes; the server may push
`assistant_text` / `assistant_audio` / `assistant_audio_chunk` frames
unprompted, mid-turn, independent of client input.

publish.summary: Frames a client sends to the server.

subscribe.summary: Frames the server sends to the client.

InputCaptureDiagnostic.description: Content-free client evidence for a failed capture epoch.
InputCaptureDiagnostic.title: InputCaptureDiagnostic

SessionHelloFrame.description:
First frame a client sends on any new physical connection. See
endpoint_session/registry.py — CONTEXT.md — Endpoint Session.

``tenant_id``/``user_id``/``device_id`` are retained only for wire
compatibility and have no authorization power. v2 identity comes from the
authenticated physical Transport Adapter.
SessionHelloFrame.title: SessionHelloFrame

PlaybackProgressFrame.description:
Client-reported playback truth for one generation's assistant audio.

`finished=True` means the client's last scheduled audio source actually
ended — the only real end-of-playback signal in the system. A client that
sends this opts the session into client-reported playback truth;
`finished=False` is reserved for
mid-playback position reporting and is currently ignored.

Untrusted input like any other inbound frame: see
the realtime transport bridge checks the generation so a stale report
cannot end the current turn. See ADR-0037.
PlaybackProgressFrame.title: PlaybackProgressFrame

PlaybackQualityFrame.description:
Aggregated terminal playback diagnostics for one Generation.

Contains timing counters only. Raw audio, transcript text, and per-chunk
samples are intentionally excluded so diagnostics remain bounded and safe.
PlaybackQualityFrame.title: PlaybackQualityFrame

TtsConfigFrame.description: Updates speech synthesis presentation for the current session.
TtsConfigFrame.title: TtsConfigFrame

SessionAckFrame.description:
Server's reply to SessionHelloFrame, confirming the session id to use
going forward and whether it was resumed or freshly minted.
SessionAckFrame.title: SessionAckFrame

UserTranscriptFrame.description:
Echoes the client's own ASR-derived transcript back to it, mirroring
how a client doing its own ASR already sees its UserTextFrame locally
before sending. The Realtime WebSocket bridge emits this from transcript
events.
UserTranscriptFrame.title: UserTranscriptFrame

AssistantSpeechTextFrame.description: Cumulative text actually submitted to the speech/TTS path.
AssistantSpeechTextFrame.title: AssistantSpeechTextFrame

AssistantResponseCompletedFrame.description: Marks the response boundary independently from its audio segments.
AssistantResponseCompletedFrame.title: AssistantResponseCompletedFrame

AssistantSpeechCancelledFrame.description:
Sent the instant τ9 confirms a barge-in: stop playing `generation`'s
audio and drop whatever is still buffered for it.

The client must also drop any `assistant_audio_chunk` for this generation
that arrives *after* this frame. Cancellation takes effect at a chunk
boundary, so one more chunk can already be in flight — and with the frame
loop and the turn task both able to call `transport.send` concurrently
(ADR-0036), their relative wire order isn't guaranteed. That late-chunk
case is why this frame carries a generation rather than being a bare
signal. See ADR-0036.
AssistantSpeechCancelledFrame.title: AssistantSpeechCancelledFrame

SessionCapabilitiesFrame.description: Advertises live speech/text capabilities after the session handshake.
SessionCapabilitiesFrame.title: SessionCapabilitiesFrame

VoiceSessionSnapshotFrame.description: Bounded semantic state used when the client's event cursor has a gap.
VoiceSessionSnapshotFrame.title: VoiceSessionSnapshotFrame

VoiceSessionEventTailFrame.description: Contiguous visible lifecycle events after a client resume cursor.
VoiceSessionEventTailFrame.title: VoiceSessionEventTailFrame
